name: Make
description: Make (formerly Integromat) is a powerful visual workflow automation platform that offers far more flexibility than Zapier for complex, multi-path automations. Its canvas-based editor supports conditional logic, data transformation, error handling, iterators, and aggregators. Make's AI tools include built-in OpenAI/Claude/Gemini integration, AI Router for multi-model logic, and an AI-powered scenario builder. Supports 1,500+ apps and custom HTTP connections.
pricingDetails: Free: 1,000 ops/month. Core: $9/month. Pro: $16/month. Teams: $29/month. Enterprise: custom.
